en.title: Ordering a LightCarbon frame: turn an email quote into a complete build plan
en.description: What to put in a LightCarbon frame inquiry, how to compare custom paint and included parts, and why conflicting support pages need a written answer.
en.intro: A quote-led purchase gives you room to choose details. It also gives you room to forget them. With LightCarbon, the best starting document is a precise frame request that your future mechanic could understand without reading twenty emails.

sections.heading: Specify the package, not just the model number
paragraphs: Use the contact route on [LightCarbon’s official site](https://www.lightcarbon.com/warranty_d10) and request a quote for the exact model, size, finish and destination. The site describes single-unit availability for many models and several payment methods; confirm the options for your order.

Ask for separate lines covering frame and fork, seatpost, cockpit, headset, axles, hanger and small parts. Then add painting, shipping and the stated treatment of import charges. An email saying frame price is not a complete delivered frameset quote.

Request the geometry and assembly documentation for the current revision. The LCR018-D shown here is an all-road example; information from another LightCarbon road or gravel frame should not silently fill its unknowns.

sections.heading: Use an owner build as a shopping-list check
paragraphs: The [Cyclists Hub LCR018-D owner interview](https://www.cyclistshub.com/lightcarbon-lcr18d-review/) describes a custom-painted, individually assembled bike and reports costs and measured weights for that particular build. It is useful for seeing how a frame purchase becomes a collection of component decisions.

Those totals are historical owner observations. They are not a current LightCarbon quotation, and the finished bike’s weight is not the bare frame’s weight. Match what was weighed and what was included before comparing numbers.

Use the story to add questions to your own list: what did the owner source separately, which choices were personal preferences, and which parts depended on the frame interface? Copying the whole build can also copy a fit choice that is wrong for you.

sections.heading: Ask which warranty terms govern your invoice
paragraphs: LightCarbon’s [warranty page](https://www.lightcarbon.com/warranty_d10) and [older after-sales page](https://www.lightcarbon.com/after-sale-service_n9) do not describe every category and shipping condition identically. Do not resolve that by choosing whichever paragraph sounds most generous.

Ask the seller to confirm the coverage period for your actual frame, when it starts, what evidence a claim needs and who pays shipping at each stage. Ask separately about replacement-part labor and crash replacement. A discounted replacement after a crash is not the same as a manufacturing-defect warranty.
Keep the answer attached to the itemized quote. If the seller cannot resolve a meaningful contradiction before purchase, that uncertainty belongs in your decision alongside price and geometry.

sections.heading: Approve production only after the parts make sense
paragraphs: Have the assembler review the interfaces and cockpit dimensions before approving paint. Ask for an estimated production window distinct from transit, and establish how the finished configuration will be confirmed before dispatch.

Use a payment route whose buyer-protection conditions you understand, with the actual goods described accurately on the invoice. Reconfirm any change to payment instructions through the known official contact route.

Your final deliverable from the conversation is one agreed specification and one total. When both are clear, custom ordering becomes manageable. When they are scattered across contradictory messages, the attractive frame price is still only a starting point.

zh-Hans.title: 订购 LightCarbon 车架：把邮件报价变成完整装车计划
zh-Hans.description: LightCarbon 询价应包含什么，如何核对定制涂装和内含配件，以及售后页面不一致时该怎么问。
zh-Hans.intro: 按需求询价能选择更多细节，也更容易漏掉细节。买 LightCarbon，最好先写一份准确需求，让之后的装车技师不用翻二十封邮件就能看懂。

sections.heading: 说清套餐，别只报型号
paragraphs: 通过 [LightCarbon 官网联系渠道](https://www.lightcarbon.com/warranty_d10)，按具体型号、尺码、涂装和目的地询价。官网描述多款支持单件购买及若干支付方式，实际订单仍需确认。
要求分别列出车架前叉、座管、把组、碗组、桶轴、尾钩和小配件，再加喷漆、运费及进口费用处理。邮件中的“车架价”不等于完整套装到手报价。
索取当前版本的几何和装配资料。照片中的 LCR018-D 是全路况例子，不能悄悄拿其他 LightCarbon 公路或砾石车架的信息补它的未知项。

sections.heading: 把车主装车当作清单参考
paragraphs: [Cyclists Hub 的 LCR018-D 车主访谈](https://www.cyclistshub.com/lightcarbon-lcr18d-review/)介绍了一辆定制涂装、单独装配的车，并报告该具体配置的费用与实测重量。它适合帮助理解车架购买如何变成一连串部件选择。
这些总额是历史车主观察，不是当前厂家报价。整车重量也不是裸车架重量。比较前，应先对齐称了什么、包含了什么。
把故事转成自己的问题：哪些部件单独购买，哪些只是个人偏好，哪些受车架接口限制？整套照抄，也可能把不适合自己的合身选择一起抄走。

sections.heading: 问清发票适用哪一版保修
paragraphs: [保修页](https://www.lightcarbon.com/warranty_d10)与[较早的售后页](https://www.lightcarbon.com/after-sale-service_n9)对某些类别和运输条件的表述并不完全一致。不能挑最宽松的段落来替自己作解释。
请卖家确认具体车架保修期限、起算时间、索赔材料，以及各阶段运费由谁承担。移装工时和摔车更换计划要单独问；摔车后折价换购不等于制造缺陷保修。
把答复与逐项报价放一起。如果付款前仍无法消除重要矛盾，这种不确定性也应和价格、几何一起进入决策。

sections.heading: 配件方案清楚后，再确认生产
paragraphs: 喷漆确认前，请装配者检查接口与把组尺寸。分别询问生产窗口和在途时间，并约定发货前如何确认最终配置。
选择自己理解买家保护条件的支付方式，发票如实写明商品。付款指示若变化，通过已知官方联系渠道重新核对。
这轮沟通最后应得到一份一致的规格和一个总额。两者清楚，定制就容易管理；若散落在相互矛盾的消息里，再好看的车架价也只是起点。
